crossRefs.note: In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill…
His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and…
Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).
Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land. A certain man of Bethlehem Judah went to live in…
The name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi. The names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion…
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…
Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to…
They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,
‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah: for out of you shall come a governor…

people.name: Bethlehem
people.line: City of David's birth and Jesus' birth.

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he lived there.
translations.bsb: And there was a young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah who had been residing within the clan of Judah.
translations.kjv: And there was a young man out of Bethlehemjudah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned
translations.asv: And there was a young man out of Beth-lehem-judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he sojourned there.
